data.title: 苍崎青子 · 雪夜车站的旅人回眸
data.description: 北国深夜飘着密集雪花的火车站台上，昏黄街灯将积雪照得格外晶亮。青子一手按在深棕色复古皮箱上转过身来，围巾与发梢在寒风中微扬，眼底闪烁着坦然从容的笑意。
data.action: standing with vintage suitcase, turning back, gentle smile
data.lighting: warm platform lanterns glowing amid gentle falling snow
data.promptProse: On a snow-dusted train station platform at night under warm lantern light, Aozaki Aoko holds a leather suitcase and glances back with a calm, confident smile.
data.animaCaption: Turning back beside her luggage on the snowy station platform, she smiles warmly beneath the street lamp.
